name: Ora
note: Scores how agent-ready a site is
summary: Ora scores how well a website or MCP server works for AI agents, checking how agents find, read and act on it, and gives letter grades with suggested fixes. It also runs Journey, which sends an agent at a site with a goal and records where it stalls, and offers a CLI (npx ax audit). Ora does the research behind the AgentReady standard.
goodFor: Finding where agents get stuck on a site
watchOut: Scores and weights can change independently of AgentReady
